units.rawText: The sound of gunfire and screams fill the air.
units.displayText: The sound of gunfire and screams fill the air.

spans.text: The sound of gunfire and screams fill the air.

units.rawText: Crimson light enters our eyes.
units.displayText: Crimson light enters our eyes.

spans.text: Crimson light enters our eyes.

units.rawText: The place where Zero should be sitting is empty, and there's no telling where it's gone. Meanwhile, the sounds of mechanical footsteps, gunshots and humans moaning in agony comes from above.
units.displayText: The place where Zero should be sitting is empty, and there's no telling where it's gone. Meanwhile, the sounds of mechanical footsteps, gunshots and humans moaning in agony comes from above.

spans.text: The place where Zero should be sitting is empty, and there's no telling where it's gone. Meanwhile, the sounds of mechanical footsteps, gunshots and humans moaning in agony comes from above.

units.rawText: Looks like it's begun attacking humans indiscriminately.
units.displayText: Looks like it's begun attacking humans indiscriminately.

spans.text: Looks like it's begun attacking humans indiscriminately.

units.rawText: It? You mean Zero?
units.displayText: It? You mean Zero?

spans.text: It? You mean Zero?

units.rawText: That can't be. It hasn't moved in years!
units.displayText: That can't be. It hasn't moved in years!

spans.text: That can't be. It hasn't moved in years!

units.rawText: That's just because you don't know, right? Dolls actually have emergency modes they can activate, you know?
units.displayText: That's just because you don't know, right? Dolls actually have emergency modes they can activate, you know?

spans.text: That's just because you don't know, right? Dolls actually have emergency modes they can activate, you know?

units.rawText: This... Boss...
units.displayText: This... Boss...

spans.text: This... Boss...

units.rawText: You didn't know about it, did you? After all, you're just a self-taught technician.
units.displayText: You didn't know about it, did you? After all, you're just a self-taught technician.

spans.text: You didn't know about it, did you? After all, you're just a self-taught technician.

units.rawText: We activated Zero's emergency mode, so right now it must have recalled its original purpose.
units.displayText: We activated Zero's emergency mode, so right now it must have recalled its original purpose.

spans.text: We activated Zero's emergency mode, so right now it must have recalled its original purpose.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, what WAS its original purpose? Serving in the military?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, what WAS its original purpose? Serving in the military?

spans.text: Speaking of which, what WAS its original purpose? Serving in the military?

units.rawText: The screams continue. The villagers grow paler and paler.
units.displayText: The screams continue. The villagers grow paler and paler.

spans.text: The screams continue. The villagers grow paler and paler.

units.rawText: What if our bros up there really were...
units.displayText: What if our bros up there really were...

spans.text: What if our bros up there really were...

units.rawText: Like I was saying, these idiots were looking down on us.
units.displayText: Like I was saying, these idiots were looking down on us.

spans.text: Like I was saying, these idiots were looking down on us.

units.rawText: Boss... We...
units.displayText: Boss... We...

spans.text: Boss... We...

units.rawText: Shut up, all of you.
units.displayText: Shut up, all of you.

spans.text: Shut up, all of you.

units.rawText: The Engineer angrily barks a command, then glares at us before activating the body-mounted weapon he's wearing.
units.displayText: The Engineer angrily barks a command, then glares at us before activating the body-mounted weapon he's wearing.

spans.text: The Engineer angrily barks a command, then glares at us before activating the body-mounted weapon he's wearing.

units.rawText: I'll go up and see what's going on. So what if Zero is moving again? It's just a written-off tool.
units.displayText: I'll go up and see what's going on. So what if Zero is moving again? It's just a written-off tool.

spans.text: I'll go up and see what's going on. So what if Zero is moving again? It's just a written-off tool.

units.rawText: You two, keep an eye on them.
units.displayText: You two, keep an eye on them.

spans.text: You two, keep an eye on them.

units.rawText: After tossing off that terse statement, the Engineer heads outside and doesn't look back.
units.displayText: After tossing off that terse statement, the Engineer heads outside and doesn't look back.

spans.text: After tossing off that terse statement, the Engineer heads outside and doesn't look back.

units.rawText: (Well done, Little Si.)
units.displayText: Well done, Little Si.

spans.text: Well done, Little Si.

units.rawText: Zero's body has not left its place—It was only knocked off the stage by Little Si.
units.displayText: Zero's body has not left its place—It was only knocked off the stage by Little Si.

spans.text: Zero's body has not left its place—It was only knocked off the stage by Little Si.

units.rawText: As for the gunshots and the flashing lights, those are from the climax of Silent Mountain, where the protagonist activates mechanical soldiers to attack the zombies. Little Si is playing that scene using the camcorder's projection feature.
units.displayText: As for the gunshots and the flashing lights, those are from the climax of Silent Mountain, where the protagonist activates mechanical soldiers to attack the zombies. Little Si is playing that scene using the camcorder's projection feature.

spans.text: As for the gunshots and the flashing lights, those are from the climax of Silent Mountain, where the protagonist activates mechanical soldiers to attack the zombies. Little Si is playing that scene using the camcorder's projection feature.

units.rawText: Those villagers sure were gullible; all we had to do was play off each other about an emergency mode or what not and they didn't dare doubt us any more.
units.displayText: Those villagers sure were gullible; all we had to do was play off each other about an emergency mode or what not and they didn't dare doubt us any more.

spans.text: Those villagers sure were gullible; all we had to do was play off each other about an emergency mode or what not and they didn't dare doubt us any more.

units.rawText: Little Si looks happily at me. If it weren't a snake, I might even want to pet it.
units.displayText: Little Si looks happily at me. If it weren't a snake, I might even want to pet it.

spans.text: Little Si looks happily at me. If it weren't a snake, I might even want to pet it.

units.rawText: You... Stay there! Don't move!
units.displayText: You... Stay there! Don't move!

spans.text: You... Stay there! Don't move!

units.rawText: The villagers turns around, waving their wrenches, but what greets them is—
units.displayText: The villagers turns around, waving their wrenches, but what greets them is—

spans.text: The villagers turns around, waving their wrenches, but what greets them is—

units.rawText: Hiss, hiss, hiss—
units.displayText: Hiss, hiss, hiss—

spans.text: Hiss, hiss, hiss—

units.rawText: Little Si has already undone our bonds, and it savagely pounces one of the villagers.
units.displayText: Little Si has already undone our bonds, and it savagely pounces one of the villagers.

spans.text: Little Si has already undone our bonds, and it savagely pounces one of the villagers.

units.rawText: Ugh! A snake?!
units.displayText: Ugh! A snake?!

spans.text: Ugh! A snake?!

units.rawText: Little Si has already coiled around his neck, and Zangyin follows up with a punch that knocks him out.
units.displayText: Little Si has already coiled around his neck, and Zangyin follows up with a punch that knocks him out.

spans.text: Little Si has already coiled around his neck, and Zangyin follows up with a punch that knocks him out.

units.rawText: You guys! Don't mess ar... urgh—
units.displayText: You guys! Don't mess ar... urgh—

spans.text: You guys! Don't mess ar... urgh—

units.rawText: Thud—
units.displayText: Thud—

spans.text: Thud—

units.rawText: While the other villager is distracted by Little Si, I take out a collection of short stories and smash it into the back of his head.
units.displayText: While the other villager is distracted by Little Si, I take out a collection of short stories and smash it into the back of his head.

spans.text: While the other villager is distracted by Little Si, I take out a collection of short stories and smash it into the back of his head.

units.rawText: Much as I hate to admit it, Zangyin and I have perfect teamwork.
units.displayText: Much as I hate to admit it, Zangyin and I have perfect teamwork.

spans.text: Much as I hate to admit it, Zangyin and I have perfect teamwork.

units.rawText: Humph! Knowledge is power.
units.displayText: Humph! Knowledge is power.

spans.text: Humph! Knowledge is power.

units.rawText: Honestly, if we hadn't been ambushed earlier and the Engineer wasn't fully kitted out, we wouldn't have to fear you!
units.displayText: Honestly, if we hadn't been ambushed earlier and the Engineer wasn't fully kitted out, we wouldn't have to fear you!

spans.text: Honestly, if we hadn't been ambushed earlier and the Engineer wasn't fully kitted out, we wouldn't have to fear you!

units.rawText: Even if we're weak, you're still no match for us!
units.displayText: Even if we're weak, you're still no match for us!

spans.text: Even if we're weak, you're still no match for us!

units.rawText: Save the rubbish for later! If that Engineer comes back and finds us, we're...
units.displayText: Save the rubbish for later! If that Engineer comes back and finds us, we're...

spans.text: Save the rubbish for later! If that Engineer comes back and finds us, we're...

units.rawText: Zangyin starts climbing out of the cellar as she says this. However...
units.displayText: Zangyin starts climbing out of the cellar as she says this. However...

spans.text: Zangyin starts climbing out of the cellar as she says this. However...

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: A gunshot suddenly rings out from above us.
units.displayText: A gunshot suddenly rings out from above us.

spans.text: A gunshot suddenly rings out from above us.

units.rawText: Zangyin?!
units.displayText: Zangyin?!

spans.text: Zangyin?!

units.rawText: Just as she finishes climbing out of the cellar, Zangyin collapses to the ground. I immediately make my way out of the cellar after her, but am met with the sight of a menacing gun barrel.
units.displayText: Just as she finishes climbing out of the cellar, Zangyin collapses to the ground. I immediately make my way out of the cellar after her, but am met with the sight of a menacing gun barrel.

spans.text: Just as she finishes climbing out of the cellar, Zangyin collapses to the ground. I immediately make my way out of the cellar after her, but am met with the sight of a menacing gun barrel.

units.rawText: Humph... You're full of tricks, aren't you?
units.displayText: Humph... You're full of tricks, aren't you?

spans.text: Humph... You're full of tricks, aren't you?

units.rawText: The Engineer glares at us. Zangyin is lying on the ground off to the side.
units.displayText: The Engineer glares at us. Zangyin is lying on the ground off to the side.

spans.text: The Engineer glares at us. Zangyin is lying on the ground off to the side.

units.rawText: Zangyin, are you alright...
units.displayText: Zangyin, are you alright...

spans.text: Zangyin, are you alright...

units.rawText: I'm fine, he didn't hit me. I was just startled and fell down.
units.displayText: I'm fine, he didn't hit me. I was just startled and fell down.

spans.text: I'm fine, he didn't hit me. I was just startled and fell down.

units.rawText: Is your leg hurt?
units.displayText: Is your leg hurt?

spans.text: Is your leg hurt?

units.rawText: I'm not that fragile.
units.displayText: I'm not that fragile.

spans.text: I'm not that fragile.

units.rawText: Hm, you're pretty solid—I can't wait to scrap you now.
units.displayText: Hm, you're pretty solid—I can't wait to scrap you now.

spans.text: Hm, you're pretty solid—I can't wait to scrap you now.

units.rawText: The Engineer interrupts our whispered conversation and approaches us, his gun held high.
units.displayText: The Engineer interrupts our whispered conversation and approaches us, his gun held high.

spans.text: The Engineer interrupts our whispered conversation and approaches us, his gun held high.

units.rawText: I have to admit, you're much more capable than the previous Dolls. To think you could run circles around me with just a pack of lies and an old camcorder.
units.displayText: I have to admit, you're much more capable than the previous Dolls. To think you could run circles around me with just a pack of lies and an old camcorder.

spans.text: I have to admit, you're much more capable than the previous Dolls. To think you could run circles around me with just a pack of lies and an old camcorder.

units.rawText: He grits his teeth and takes aim at my camera.
units.displayText: He grits his teeth and takes aim at my camera.

spans.text: He grits his teeth and takes aim at my camera.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: The machine shatters to bits, and the noise suddenly stops.
units.displayText: The machine shatters to bits, and the noise suddenly stops.

spans.text: The machine shatters to bits, and the noise suddenly stops.
